name: critical-php-errors
title: Critical PHP errors are repeatedly occurring
description: Critical PHP errors have been written to the application logs during each of the last five minutes. This normally indicates a repeated application failure that requires investigation.
investigation_steps: Review the matching logs and identify the error causing this alert.
Check for recent deployments, failed tasks or unhealthy containers that could be causing the errors.
Raise a bug or incident if further investigation is required, or resolve the issue if the cause is known.
